task: Evaluate computational power of random quantum circuit sampling (RCS) on arbitrary geometries using provided experimental counts and ideal probabilities/amplitudes.
required_methods: Cross-entropy benchmarking (XEB) fidelity estimation from measured bitstring counts matched to ideal probabilities
Uncertainty estimate for each (N, d, r) configuration
Depth scan for fixed N=40 using available verification data
Comparison/validation plots addressing fidelity decay and classical approximability gap
primary_quantity: XEB fidelity F_XEB = 2^N * mean_sample[p_ideal(x)] - 1, computed counts-weighted over matched bitstrings
initial_assumptions: Available workspace data contains N=40 verification subsets only unless inspection shows otherwise.
Ideal files may contain amplitudes or probabilities; code will normalize to ideal probabilities.
Uncertainty will include multinomial/sample standard error over matched measured samples, with bootstrap/checks where practical.
